summary: Python Backend Developer with hands-on experience building **FastAPI** services and **RAG** systems using **LLMs** and vector search. built an AI-powered resume builder with **NLP** pipelines, JWT authentication, and Docker containerization on **AWS EC2**. experience.title: Full Stack Developer
bullets: Built a client inventory management system using **React**, **Node.js**, and **PostgreSQL**, handling authentication, REST APIs, and database schema design.
Implemented **Prisma ORM** for type-safe database migrations, catching schema errors at compile time during rapid iteration cycles.
Migrated a client application to **Cloudflare Workers**, reducing cold-start latency from **2+ seconds to under 100ms**.

experience.title: Software Engineer Intern
bullets: Delivered **REST APIs** endpoints within the first week using **Node.js** and Express.js for three backend service modules.
Optimized **SQL Server** queries by implementing proper indexing, reducing average response time by **60%** for requests that were timing out under load.
Resolved a frontend performance issue by fixing missing Redux selectors, eliminating redundant network calls on route changes.
Contributed to code quality through small, reviewable pull requests and participated in Agile sprint retrospectives using **Jira** for task tracking.

projects.name: Resume AI
bullets: Built an AI-powered resume builder that generates tailored resumes with **ATS keyword-matching scores** and auto-rewrite functionality.
Implemented a **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)** system in **FastAPI** using TF-IDF vectorization to retrieve relevant HR guidelines before generating content.
Reduced generation time from **75s to under 30s** by parallelizing independent tasks with Python thread pools.
Deployed frontend to Vercel and backend to **AWS EC2** inside **Docker** with configured volumes, environment secrets, and CORS headers.

projects.name: Notes App
bullets: Built a full-stack note-taking application from scratch to understand the complete request lifecycle without starter templates.
Implemented **JWT authentication** on **Express.js** backend with **MongoDB** storage and React/Redux state management on the frontend.
Designed server-side search with chained Mongoose filters and optimized sort order for note pinning across both backend queries and Redux state.
